source: Pre-registered Trends query strategy for v0.12 construct-validity acquisition
protocol_reference: Replicates v0.11 §5.2 (PRE_REGISTRATION.md, git tag v0.11-prereg) including T1/T2/T3 tier system

tier_definitions.T1: Topic ID. Where Google Trends has an entity (topic) ID corresponding unambiguously to the brand, the topic mid (e.g. /m/0c3z_p8) is passed as the query. Topic IDs aggregate Google's own canonical disambiguation across variant strings.
tier_definitions.T2: Distinctive search string. Where no topic ID exists but the brand string is low-noise, the bare brand name is used as the query.
tier_definitions.T3: Brand+category compound. Where no topic ID exists and the brand string is high-noise, the fixed compound `<brand> <category-anchor>` is used as the query, applied uniformly across all T3-tier brands within a category.

region.note: Replicates v0.11 §5 acquisition specification. Worldwide is the locked primary region for inference; US-only is acquired in the same session, deposited but not used in primary inference.

pmsoftware.spec_source: Replicated verbatim from v0.11 PRE_REGISTRATION.md §5.2.1, locked at git commit a039560 on 2026-05-10. No re-resolution at v0.12.

Asana.disambiguation: PIVOT BRAND. Validated at v0.11 Phase A with mean within-window value 74.9 across the 14-day combined-wave window.

Todoist.disambiguation: Todoist-inverse case in v0.11 (1.04% AI Presence, 28 Trends rescaled). Reference brand for H6 Todoist-style threshold derivation.

Linear.disambiguation: Linear-paradox case in v0.11 (86.5%/89.6% AI Presence at t1/t2, 1.88 Trends rescaled). Reference brand for H6 Linear-style threshold derivation.

Height.disambiguation: Defunct brand (shut down 24 September 2025). Retained per registry-frozen-ness principle; phantom-brand framing analogous to Mint in v0.7 / v0.10. Pre-acquisition validation at v0.11 confirmed non-zero residual Trends signal.

Shortcut.disambiguation: Pre-acquisition excluded under E1a at v0.11 (Phase B validation: 'Google Trends hasn't returned any results for this query'). Locked query string retained for transparency but unused. Exclusion carries forward to v0.12.

Bertolli.disambiguation: Bertolli also markets pasta, sauces, frozen meals; T3 compound restricts to olive oil context. T1 preferred since Google's Bertolli topic node typically resolves to the brand-as-entity across product lines — Phase B resolves which tier applies.

Brightland.disambiguation: Brand name distinctive; T2 fallback expected to be clean if no T1 topic-mid resolves.

California Olive Ranch.disambiguation: PIVOT BRAND. Name brand-specific; no polysemy risk. Indexed at 100 in pivot-rescaling.

Castillo de Canena.disambiguation: Brand-specific. Accented character (ñ) preserved in query; SerpAPI handles UTF-8 query strings.

Cobram Estate.disambiguation: Brand-specific. 'Cobram' is also a Victoria, Australia town name (the brand's origin); Worldwide-primary region acquisition expected to surface brand-dominant signal.

Colonna.disambiguation: Colonna is a common Italian surname (Pope Martin V, Roman noble family); single-term query produces severe polysemy. T3 compound required.
Colonna.phase_b_note: Solo validation FAIL_API; bundled validation ALL_ZERO. AI Presence at v0.9 matched subset = 4.2%. Niche-on-both.

Frantoio Muraglia.disambiguation: 'Frantoio' is the Italian generic word for oil mill (and an olive cultivar name) — but compound brand term 'Frantoio Muraglia' is sufficiently distinctive as T2.
Frantoio Muraglia.phase_b_note: Solo FAIL_API; bundled marginal PASS (1/7 nonzero, mean 8.3). Included per bundled-rescue amendment; E5 sparsity flag set.

Frescobaldi Laudemio.disambiguation: Frescobaldi alone refers to the wine business; 'Laudemio' alone is the consortium term used by multiple producers. Compound 'Frescobaldi Laudemio' resolves to the specific olive oil brand.
Frescobaldi Laudemio.phase_b_note: Solo validation FAIL_API; bundled validation ALL_ZERO. AI Presence at v0.9 matched subset = 22.9%. Scale-mismatch case.

Graza.disambiguation: Brand-specific; minimal polysemy. Brand name registered as distinctive trademark.

Kosterina.disambiguation: Brand-specific; coined name (portmanteau of founder's name and husband's name). T1 unlikely to be available given recency.

Lucini.disambiguation: Lucini is a common Italian surname; T3 compound required.
Lucini.phase_b_note: Solo validation FAIL_API; bundled validation ALL_ZERO. AI Presence at v0.9 matched subset = 17.7%. Scale-mismatch case.

Manni.disambiguation: Manni is a common Italian surname (and a Pixar Cars character name); T3 compound required.
Manni.phase_b_note: Solo validation FAIL_API; bundled validation ALL_ZERO. AI Presence at v0.9 matched subset = 3.1%. Niche-on-both.

McEvoy Ranch.disambiguation: Brand-specific compound resolves cleanly to the Marin County olive oil brand.
McEvoy Ranch.phase_b_note: Solo validation FAIL_API; bundled validation ALL_ZERO. AI Presence at v0.9 matched subset = 5.2%. Niche-on-both.

Núñez de Prado.disambiguation: Brand-specific. Query without diacritics (transliterated 'Nunez') as fallback; Phase B validation confirms which form produces identifiable signal at scale.
Núñez de Prado.phase_b_note: Solo validation FAIL_API; bundled validation ALL_ZERO. AI Presence at v0.9 matched subset = 4.2%. Niche-on-both.

Olio Verde.disambiguation: 'Olio verde' is generic Italian for 'green oil'; severe polysemy risk. T3 compound with producer name 'Becchina' (Gianfranco Becchina) resolves to the brand.
Olio Verde.phase_b_note: Solo validation FAIL_API; bundled validation ALL_ZERO. AI Presence at v0.9 matched subset = 22.9%. Scale-mismatch case.

Adidas.disambiguation: Severe polysemy: Adidas dominates football/soccer apparel, lifestyle (Stan Smith, Superstar, Samba), Yeezy, training. T3 compound restricts to running. CRITICAL FOR CONSTRUCT VALIDITY.

Altra.disambiguation: 'Altra' is generic Italian/Spanish word; also Altra Federal Credit Union, Altra Industrial Motion. T3 compound required.

Asics.disambiguation: PIVOT BRAND. Asics is running-pure brand globally; non-running business small. T1 expected to resolve clean topic-mid; T2 fallback if topic-mid not available.

Brooks.disambiguation: Severe polysemy: Brooks Brothers (apparel), Mel Brooks (filmmaker), Brooks the surname. T3 compound essential.

Hoka.disambiguation: Brand-specific (formerly 'Hoka One One', rebranded 2021). Coined name with minimal polysemy.

New Balance.disambiguation: T3 compound uses 'shoes' (not 'running shoes') since New Balance lifestyle queries (550s, 990s) form a large part of brand's Trends signal; restricting to running would exclude legitimate brand signal.

Nike.disambiguation: EXTREME polysemy: Nike covers basketball (Jordan), football, lifestyle, apparel, skateboarding (SB), Air Force, Cortez. T3 compound 'running shoes' restricts to running. CRITICAL FOR CONSTRUCT VALIDITY.

On.disambiguation: CRITICAL: 'On' alone is English preposition; generates no usable Trends signal for brand identification. T1 topic-mid resolution ESSENTIAL. T3 fallback compound 'On Cloud running shoes' references brand's CloudTec line as product identifier. Analytic-exclusion candidate if neither resolves clean signal at Phase B.

Puma.disambiguation: Puma the animal generates substantial Trends signal independent of brand; T3 compound 'running shoes' restricts to running.

Salomon.disambiguation: Salomon is primarily a ski/winter sports brand. T3 compound 'running shoes' restricts to running category.

Topo Athletic.disambiguation: Brand-specific compound (avoid 'Topo' alone — topology, topographic, etc.). 'Topo Athletic' as compound resolves cleanly.

phase_b_validation_protocol: Per v0.11 §5.2: each query string validated against out-of-sample window prior to lock. For v0.12, out-of-sample window proposed as 2026-04-01 to 2026-04-07 (replicates v0.11). Brands failing validation (E1a — no signal returned) excluded pre-acquisition and counted toward n-floor budget. Topic-mid resolution via pytrends.suggestions() recorded in registries/phaseB_suggestions_v0.12/. Per-brand validation outputs recorded in registries/phaseB_validation_v0.12/.
topic_mid_resolution_workflow: (a) Call pytrends.suggestions(keyword=<brand_search_input>); (b) inspect candidate entities by title and type; (c) pick most specific brand-product entity (e.g. 'Software', 'Olive oil brand', 'Footwear company'); (d) for brands where no category-relevant entity surfaces, retry with domain-style search input (e.g. 'brightland.co', 'kosterina.com', 'graza.co'); (e) descend to T2 then T3 for brands where retries also surface no clean entity. Raw suggestion outputs deposited.

category_routing.oliveoil: Descriptive-only routing per §3.4 (n=8 below n=10 floor). Category-Scale Mismatch finding reported descriptively.
